_note: Provisional engineering conventions for the parameters the derived concepts and the operationalization table expose (ATOMS.md §8–§9). Values are in the units the corpus itself uses (feet, miles per hour, seconds, minutes); the decoder scales them to Core units. Every value here is a reading choice to be reviewed, not a statement of the law; figures the law states are declared on the rule's span as literals, not here.

params.name: p.stop_speed
params.convention: speed below which a body counts as halted (sensor noise floor)

params.name: p.stop_span
params.convention: span of speed below p.stop_speed that counts as a stop (a 'complete cessation from movement' must be observable across samples)

params.name: p.standing_span
params.convention: span beyond which a halt is standing, not a momentary stop

params.name: p.queue_gap
params.convention: longitudinal gap within which a halted vehicle ahead makes the halt a queue

params.name: p.following_gap
params.convention: range within which a same-lane vehicle ahead is followed

params.name: p.headway
params.convention: reasonable-and-prudent following: the two-second headway convention

params.name: p.ttc_bound
params.convention: time to conflict below which proximity is a hazard (conflict-analysis convention)

params.name: p.ttc_horizon
params.convention: projection horizon for time to conflict

params.name: p.lateral_clearance
params.convention: safe lateral clearance when passing (bicycle-passing convention)

params.name: p.turn_angle
params.convention: heading change that counts as a turn

params.name: p.turn_window
params.convention: window over which a turn's heading change is measured

params.name: p.u_turn_window
params.convention: window over which a heading reversal is measured

params.name: p.u_turn_tolerance
params.convention: tolerance about a half turn

params.name: p.lane_change_gap
params.convention: gap the adjacent lane must offer for a feasible lane change

params.name: p.approach_distance
params.convention: distance from a region's boundary within which a body approaches it

params.name: p.cleared_distance
params.convention: distance past a line or rail beyond which it is cleared

params.name: p.same_direction_cos
params.convention: heading cosine above which two users travel the same way (about 25 degrees)

params.name: p.oncoming_cos
params.convention: heading cosine of opposition for oncoming traffic

params.name: p.wrong_way_cos
params.convention: heading cosine of opposition to a lane's direction that counts as wrong way

params.name: p.arrival_tolerance
params.convention: simultaneity of arrival at an intersection

params.name: p.hard_decel
params.convention: deceleration that counts as sudden

params.name: p.stopping_decel
params.convention: design deceleration of the stopping-sight-distance model

params.name: p.reaction_time
params.convention: design perception-reaction time of the stopping-sight-distance model

params.name: p.speed_margin
params.convention: margin below the posted or prevailing speed that counts as impeding

params.name: p.traffic_range
params.convention: range within which same-direction users define prevailing speed

params.name: p.impede_span
params.convention: span of impeding that counts

params.name: p.signal_distance
params.convention: distance over which a turn or lane-change signal must have been shown

params.name: p.loading_span
params.convention: span of a halt that counts as expeditious loading or unloading

params.name: p.sunset_offset
params.convention: offset after sunset and before sunrise defining night for lamp duties

params.name: p.forced_halt_gap
params.convention: gap to a halted vehicle ahead, a stop line or a sign that forces a halt

_fields.aggregates: optional operator overrides only: word, classes (ru.* ids or other words). The run derives every aggregate the laws use from the corpus definitions (results/<run>/reading.json, for review); an operator entry here takes precedence over the derived one.
